name: Ground Beef
siboNotes: Plain ground beef is naturally FODMAP-free and well-tolerated in SIBO. Choose lean varieties and avoid processed versions with added seasonings that may contain garlic or onion.
preparationTips: Choose lean ground beef (85/15 or 90/10) to reduce fat content
Season with FODMAP-friendly herbs like oregano, thyme, or rosemary
Avoid pre-seasoned varieties that may contain onion or garlic powder
Cook thoroughly to 160°F internal temperature for food safety
